name: Surgery Kit
description: Essential tool used to extract body parts (Hearts, Limbs, Eyes) from defeated enemies. Required for Contracts and Crafting.
usage: Equip and use on a downed enemy. Don't move during animation.

name: Wipe Potion
description: Resets all your stat points, allowing you to re-spec your build.

name: Contract Reset
description: Removes a contract you no longer want.

name: Fiend Talent Unlock
description: Enables or disables visual Fiend features/talents.
